page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.180xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 720 dedicated virtual cores powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8490H processor operating at a clock frequency of 1.9 GHz. Accompanied by 12,288 GB of system memory, the instance delivers approximately 17.07 GB of RAM per vCPU, placing it in the ultra-high memory tier of enterprise cloud infrastructure.

Network connectivity is supported by a 192 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating extensive interconnect traffic and high-volume data ingress and egress. The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistent disk operations. Furthermore, the configuration contains zero onboard GPUs and allocates no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an architectural standpoint, consolidating 720 dedicated execution threads and 12 TB of RAM into a single node provides exceptional memory density for monolithic systems, eliminating network latency inherent in distributed clusters. The configuration is primarily matched to extreme in-memory databases, massive caching installations, large-scale data analytics, and enterprise SAP HANA workloads.
